# Type Morph

**Morph › Type** · v1.0.0 · 40 frames at 30 fps (20–90)

A word melts into another word with a gooey liquid morph while the scene behind changes.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/type-morph@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Title and keyword swaps
- Explainers ("this becomes that")
- Kinetic typography

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import typeMorph from './transitions/07-morph/type/type-morph';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(typeMorph, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 40 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string | `"BEFORE"` |  | Word on scene A. |
| `to` | string | `"AFTER"` |  | Word on scene B. |
| `color` | color | `"#111111"` |  | Word colour. |
| `panel` | color | `"#FF4F1A"` |  | Colour of the band behind the word; use the incoming scene's background colour. |
